full_sentence: Never before had the team faced such a difficult deadline.

options.text: faces such a difficult deadline every year.
options.why_wrong: The present simple does not match the past perfect 'had' in the stem, which requires a past participle.

options.text: they will face such a deadline.
options.why_wrong: A future form does not fit the inverted past perfect structure set up by 'never before had'.

options.text: the deadline was such a difficult one.
options.why_wrong: This clause changes the subject and does not describe the team's experience, so it breaks the structure the stem began.

grammar_focus: Negative adverbial fronting with subject-auxiliary inversion (never before + had + subject + past participle)
explanation: When a negative adverbial such as never before opens the sentence, the auxiliary 'had' moves in front of the subject and the main verb takes the past participle form. Learners may find this inversion unusual because the subject normally comes first in their first language.
translation: Daha önce hiçbir zaman ekip bu kadar zorlu bir son tarihle karşılaşmamıştı.
